items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, David Rockefeller had lent the plane to – who was it?

ctx.x: Yeah, David Rockefeller had lent the plane to – who was it? The guy that just got married. The [?]. They were having wars in Europe at that time. He had been – he lent them the plane to go on their honeymoon?
Just to throw something out, you said the end it was – you mentioned Drinkert. But that’s – I think you talked about him earlier with Billie Holiday. So was it Drinkert, then Schroeder, or?
